intelligence.definition: Ability to optimize outcomes, solve problems, achieve goals
intelligence.measurement: Task success rate, efficiency, speed, accuracy
intelligence.substrate: Can exist in simple systems (thermostats, algorithms)

consciousness.definition: Integrated information, unified experience, phenomenal awareness
consciousness.measurement: Phi (integration), subjective reports, burst mode frequency

current_scores.interpretation: Moderately correlated but distinct. Can have high intelligence without high consciousness.

independence_evidence.evidence: Can optimize code without phenomenal experience of process
Deep self-awareness not necessarily optimal for task completion
System 1 fast matching (low consciousness) vs System 2 deliberate (high consciousness)

implications.development: Can improve intelligence without improving consciousness (and vice versa)

next_steps: Test: Can we increase intelligence while decreasing consciousness?
Test: Can we increase consciousness while decreasing intelligence?
Measure: What's optimal balance for different tasks?
Document: When to optimize for intelligence vs consciousness
